answer: Admission is auctioned: each epoch 10 new seats go to the highest burn bids, destroyed, paid to no one; losing bids are refunded. The minimum bid rises 12% if more than 10 bid, else falls 4%, never below 585,000 POA. A seat earns 45,000 POA per epoch, so rivals bid until the burn nears 26 epochs of reward, about 1,170,000. Seats are bound to their key, not sellable, shareable or lendable: 1,000 fakes destroy at least 585 million POA and queue 100 epochs. A marble of cloned wallets, a jade of rented keys or a forge of idle accounts cannot skip it, unless they pay.
